verdict.rationale: MoQ documents a public test relay and a default demo that starts a relay, publishes a test video and opens the web player. Together these give developers a non-production place to test publishing and subscribing. However, nothing describes a formal sandbox with isolation guarantees or a way to keep test traffic separate from production broadcasts. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or staging mode with explicit isolation from production data, guidance on test credentials or namespaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the test relay safely.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A public test relay runs at `https://cdn.moq.dev/anon`.
The default demo starts a relay, publishes a test video, and opens the web player.
